objective: Safely improve and release the original read-only S1 Agent Operations Cockpit without introducing a second authority.

lanes.name: Infrastructure and owners
lanes.question: Can the infrastructure and owners requirement be verified without new authority?
lanes.hypothesis: A source-only projection can reduce rediscovery without authorizing a duplicate control plane.
lanes.falsifier: A secondary durable writable queue, scheduler or unbound source evidence appears.

lanes.name: Agent machine interface
lanes.question: Can the agent machine interface requirement be verified without new authority?
lanes.hypothesis: A versioned read-only machine object can preserve SHA, clock and negative gate classifications.
lanes.falsifier: A schema consumer infers permission or omits unknown gates.

lanes.name: GitHub release intelligence
lanes.question: Can the github release intelligence requirement be verified without new authority?
lanes.hypothesis: Exact-head gates can reject stale reviews, wrong run SHAs and changed main.
lanes.falsifier: A known stale, missing or mismatched source becomes release success.

lanes.name: Private source and Grok boundaries
lanes.question: Can the private source and grok boundaries requirement be verified without new authority?
lanes.hypothesis: Public projection can abstain from Bridge and Alpha data without credential leak.
lanes.baseline: Browser does not fetch private data.
lanes.falsifier: Any private raw data, token or false Grok formal approval reaches public UI.

lanes.name: Recovery and financial protection
lanes.question: Can the recovery and financial protection requirement be verified without new authority?
lanes.hypothesis: Every HIGH_IMPACT candidate needs independent custody, separation and exact-source release evidence.
lanes.baseline: Historical green backup run as proof.
lanes.falsifier: Old restore, unbound expense or self-attestation passes a current release gate.

lanes.name: Owner UX and status communication
lanes.question: Can the owner ux and status communication requirement be verified without new authority?
lanes.hypothesis: Mobile and desktop can show evidence without converting stale observations into success.
lanes.falsifier: Mobile overflow, broken selection or misleading cached/live labels.

lanes.name: Autonomy measurement and agent attribution
lanes.question: Can the autonomy measurement and agent attribution requirement be verified without new authority?
lanes.hypothesis: Scheduled S1 work can be distinguished from direct interactive contributions using native provenance.
lanes.baseline: Count any merged PR as S1 autonomous.
lanes.falsifier: Manual merge or advisory output raises natural S1 completion score.

lanes.name: Hosting, deployment and resilience
lanes.question: Can the hosting, deployment and resilience requirement be verified without new authority?
lanes.hypothesis: An optional Pages-dist subroute preserves canonical CN and can be separately verified.
lanes.baseline: No Pages route for standalone tools.
lanes.falsifier: CN build regression or publication claim without CDN readback.
